# Samson P G — extended context

## Full biography (citable)

Samson P G is a full-stack engineer and independent software founder based in Kerala, India. He operates Acsaven, the parent studio behind TryTokka and three privacy-first browser utilities (TryQuickImg, TryDevSnip, TryCalculatingNow). Before founding Acsaven he shipped production React and TypeScript at Benagon on 20X, a healthcare staffing CRM for UK and international care agencies. His path into software runs through Brototype (MERN, 2023), an independent SoundShoppie ecommerce build with live payments, and a decade of creative production work in Bahrain (Actual Advertising — print, fabrication, design under deadline).

This portfolio documents **clickable proof**: live product URLs, offline demos, demo videos, and published packages — not slide-deck claims.
